title: misc-marketing-moodboard-2026-q1
content:
Slide 1 - Header: Misc Marketing Moodboard (Q1 2026)

Purpose: Catch-all repository of low-effort creative ideas, placeholder images, promo concepts, and random assets we keep in the misc bucket. Not production-ready. Use for inspiration or throwaway experiments.

Notes / stream-of-consciousness:
- Colors: try combinations that feel tech + friendly — #00A3FF (accent), #0F172A (deep), #F6F8FA (soft) but also test saturated orange (#FF6B35) for event stickers.
- Voice: short, slightly witty, engineer-first. Avoid over-promising performance specs in creative copy.
- Imagery: candid team photos, coworking spaces, GPU racks (abstracted), coffee stains, doodles.

Placeholders / image filenames (do not assume final rights):
- img-event-sticker-v1.png (sticker dimensions 600x600)
- img-hackathon-photo-2024-07.jpg (low res)
- img-gpu-rack-abstract.svg (vector)
- meme-fallback-please-wait.gif (for humor)

Random scraps / micro-copy ideas:
- "Serving ideas at < 50ms" (too specific? leave as joke option)
- "Ship more, wait less." (short tagline candidate)
- "Latency is a feature." (internal joke)

Unsorted todo (quick):
- [ ] Collect higher-res photos from events (owner: Jenna)
- [ ] Generate 3 sticker variants for conference booth (owner: Miguel)
- [ ] Run quick A/B on orange vs blue CTA for email header (owner: Sasha)

Weird unrelated items saved here (because someone dropped them):
- Soccer schedule: Redwood Cup pickup, Saturdays 10:00am - meet at Pier 14 (not a marketing asset, but it was pasted here)
- Invoice stub: invoice_12345.pdf (appears to be an AWS pass-through invoice, move to finance if needed)

Random copy snippets (rough):
- "Bring the power of modern inference to your app — without the ops headache." (longer hero)
- "Redwood Inference: keep your models warm and your costs cool." (cheesy)

Internal references (quick):
- See Confluence: go-to-market/brand-guidelines for approved logos/clearspace
- Draft demo deck: drive://shared_drives/go-to-market/decks/q1-demo-draft (not here)

Slide-level experiments (ideas):
- A: Minimal hero + animated sticker (sticker cycles through 3 one-liners)
- B: Product screenshot + cost/latency micrograph (fake data for visual only)
- C: Team photo mosaic + quote bubble (humanize the infra)

Usage guidance:
- Anything in this file is disposable; move final assets to shared_drives/go-to-market/brand-assets with proper naming and license metadata.

Odd annotations found in comments: (copy-pasted)
- "also can we get a vector of the squirrel mascot? iirc we never made one — M.R."
- "if we use GPUs in the art, blur model names (no marketing claims)"

Last quick note: this document intentionally messy. If you land something actually useful, please: add final files, update linked_artifacts, set status -> final and include license info on the asset files.
-- end of moodboard dump --
